source.scope: one exclusively assigned original ZIP source verifier
source.defect: While reading an original ZIP part, R08 compared the initial candidate.stat() with fstat(opened descriptor) after reading; replacing the pathname after the read with a foreign inode holding identical bytes left those checks passing. The physical part at the path was no longer the one hashed.
source.fix: After fd close, lstat the source-part pathname and compare dev/inode/size/mtime_ns against the opened descriptor; reject symlink, missing path or identity drift before SourceLock can claim verified inputs. No change to ZIP member validation or output publisher.
source.limitation: An uncooperative writer can still race after final lstat; this is not an OS-level immutable snapshot or a substitute for complete physical SHA verification.

newLesson: A Git blob ID, even a correct cryptographic hash of bytes read from an open descriptor, does not guarantee that the current input path still names that inode. Check post-read pathname identity and reject drift before publishing a SourceLock receipt; keep overall archive validity HOLD until physically tested end-to-end.
